name: AltSpace 2.2.0 — Security Hardening & Reliability Release
features: Rust backend authoritative security boundary with zero plaintext secrets or tokens across IPC
Parameter-bound, single-use, 60s-expiring approval challenge tokens for privileged operations
Native Rust AI engine (byok.rs) supporting Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, and OpenRouter
Piped stdin process authentication (curl.exe --config -) preventing command-line argument snooping
Windows DPAPI-backed GitHub OAuth and credential storage with automatic localStorage scrubbing
Unified Capability Matrix with Option A Settings & Option C Omnibar hot-toggles (> toggle <id>)
Intelligent Port & Process Recovery with Toolhelp32 process tree forensics and TCP table polling
100% Offline Developer Transform Toolkit (JWT inspector, JSON <-> YAML, Regex lab, UUID v4, SHA-256)
Docker & WSL2 Cockpit with live container controls, vmmem RAM detection & 1-click memory reclaim
fixes: Contained unbrokered shell execution and terminal launching (disabled fail-closed commands)
Contained community script extensions with preserved manifests and BlockedForMigration status
Enforced Authenticode signature verification in install.ps1 with publisher validation
Removed latent phantom named_pipe module and flawed cache reset logic
Masked environment profile variables before return to WebView2 context
Sanitized action ledger and diagnostic ring buffers with multi-pattern credential redactor
